name: gazzumatteo-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins and skills by Matteo Gazzurelli — testing, automation, and productivity tools for NQL and beyond

plugins.name: e2e-testing
plugins.description: End-to-end testing workflow: create checklists from code, validate them against changes, and execute via Playwright. Unifies cloud (Claude) and local (LM Studio) executors behind a single `/run-checklist` dispatcher that auto-routes based on $E2E_EXECUTOR. v0.5.4 adds an `e2e-vision` MCP server with `analyze_image(path, prompt)` so Claude can offload PNG analysis to LM Studio (~30 tokens vs ~1800 for inline Read). Structured markdown + JSON reports.

plugins.name: code-optimizer
plugins.description: Scan, plan, apply, and verify code optimizations across 11 categories (dedup, type consolidation, dead code, cycles, type strengthening, error handling, AI-slop, complexity, magic constants, naming, excessive parameters). Multi-language (TS/JS, Python, generic). Regression-safe via baseline + per-batch rollback.

plugins.name: mobile-testing
plugins.description: Direct iOS Simulator and Android Emulator control without MobAI desktop app — zero rate limits. Pluggable backends: native (xcrun simctl + adb + Quartz) and Appium (XCUITest + UIAutomator2). v0.1.8 adds `analyze_screenshot` and `analyze_image` MCP tools so Claude can offload PNG analysis to LM Studio (~30 tokens vs ~1800 for inline Read). Single `/mobile-runner` dispatcher auto-routes cloud vs local based on $MOBILE_EXECUTOR. Same 14 device-control tools and DSL v0.2 as MobAI MCP.
